articles.title: Beige Book: Eight of 12 districts report growth as wage pressures pick up
articles.expand: Eight districts reported growth in the slight to moderate range, and four reported no change. In October, nine grew and three were unchanged. Consumer spending was little changed as households remained price sensitive and selective. Employment rose slightly on balance, with hiring mostly to replace attrition. Wages and benefits rose moderately, up from modest in the prior report. Prices increased moderately overall, as in the prior period. Input cost growth generally outpaced increases in selling prices.
